title: A Winter for the Bell
author: Rafael Coldharbour
blurb: Ansel Eriksen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
